title: 1980 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ43
story: The FJ43 is the short-wheelbase soft-top variant of the 40-series Land Cruiser — never sold new in the U.S., which makes a clean example like this one a rare find on American roads.

This truck presents in factory-correct form: canvas top over a steel roll structure, chrome bumpers front and rear, BFGoodrich All-Terrain tires, and a rear-mounted jerry can on the spare tire carrier. The 3.9L F-series inline-six and 4-speed manual are original to the platform.
Photographed around Charleston, where it turned heads on every block it passed. Sold to a buyer who'd been watching for a first-year FJ43 for over a year.
